scope: In-game names of optics added after the optic render-FOV report of 2026-09-16, in its opticNames shape, for scripts/frosty-individual-optics.py. A row may also restate an earlier optic whose shown name changed (displayName). Names and labels only; no render FOV or zoom was read.

descriptions: Moderately magnified optic with a clear sight picture.
opticNames.evidence: 2.1.2.0 fs_us_loc string 149AA226 'PA-SL 2.50x' (in 2.1.1.0 the id read 'ST Prism 5.00x'; the Steiner sight moved to a new id); AAM records '<weapon> - SCP - PAC25' link common/ui/static/metadata/attachments/shared/ad_pac25 (label 'Scope 2.50x', description 423A4775) on 61 weapons. Research repo docs/updates/2.1.2.0-checklist.md row U1.

ironSightVariants.evidence: 2.1.2.0 multiplayer name list: each record links the name string given (fs_us_loc). Both records cost 5 and bind U_WPM_IronSights. The game has no default sight; "first" is the one the site treats as the weapon's iron sights. The operator chose the Classic sights as the first on 25 Oct 2026; both names were confirmed in game by the operator on 10 Nov 2026.
